description: If you feel unrepresented, take action and make District 27 voices heard this November! Join the Voter Engagement team, become a neighborhood captain, raise your hand to sign wave, make calls to neighbors, or show your support with a sign in your yard or community. Most importantly, talk about the campaign with your friends and family!
